description: Search public scans with the ScanMalware Query Language (SMQL): field filters such as domain:paypal.com, ip:1.2.3.4, favicon_hash:<mmh3>, js_sha256:<hash>, jarm:<fingerprint> or title:login, combined with AND, OR, NOT, a leading - and parentheses; ranges such as submitted:last7d or js_risk_score:60..100; existence checks such as has:malware. Defanged indicators (paypal[.]com) are accepted. Paginated (page up to 1000, limit up to 100); sort is newest, oldest, url, load_time or ip_count; count_only returns only the number of matches. An unknown filter is rejected with a suggested correction. Broad wildcard queries can take tens of seconds.

count_only.description: Return only the number of matching scans, without results; faster when only the count is needed.
count_only.title: Count Only

q.description: SMQL query, for example domain:paypal.com AND title:login; up to 2000 characters.
q.title: Q

sort.description: Result order: newest (default), oldest, url, load_time or ip_count.
sort.title: Sort

name: search_smql
title: Search SMQL
